text: Staff from the Gender Equity Unit, People and Equity, will present proposed areas of focus for the Committee based on research, staff consultations and past community consultations. Members will provide feedback and narrow the scope of the work plan in accordance with their expertise and knowledge of community needs.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory requested the Gender Equity Unit, People and Equity report back on the Workplan based on the feedback from the Committee.
